Hi Emily / security team —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire and confirming the call. Per our internal prep, attaching: 
- SOC2-Report-summary.pdf (high-level controls and our auditor statement)
- redwood_subprocessor_matrix_2026-05-27.xlsx (updated labels: inference providers vs observability)

Quick answers to your key items below — happy to expand on the call: 
1) SOC 2: Redwood holds a SOC 2 Type II report covering Security and Availability controls; summary attached. We can share the full report under an NDA.

2) HIPAA / BAA: We can execute a BAA for pilot or production. For Hosted: we offer a BAA with scoping controls (ingress/egress restrictions, logging, access controls). For Private: customer-managed networking and BYOK reduce our access to PHI. Monica is looping in legal for template timing.

3) Encryption & KMS: Data in transit is TLS 1.2+. At rest we use provider-managed encryption by default. We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Private deployments and offer envelope-key integrations for Hosted (customer KMS integrated with our encryption layer). If you require a specific KMS provider (AWS KMS, Google KMS, Azure Key Vault) let us know and Karthik will confirm compatibility.

4) Data residency & subprocessors: For the pilot we will restrict processing to U.S. regions (AWS us-east-1 primary). The attached subprocessor matrix labels which vendors process request content (inference backends, model weights hosting) versus those that only handle telemetry/metrics/logs. Short summary: inference + KV cache = Redwood-managed hosts in US; telemetry and metrics may be sent to third-party observability tools listed in the matrix (these are only aggregated metrics, not full request bodies).

5) Audit logs & retention: We capture request-level metadata for debugging and security (request id, timestamps, model variant). Access to those logs is role-based and can be scoped per-customer. Retention policies are configurable; default retention is 90 days for detailed logs and 1 year for aggregated metrics — we can extend per contract.

Next steps:
- Please have your security team drop prioritized questions into the questionnaire PDF — we’ll start filling the doc and flag items requiring legal.
- Send any NDA request for full SOC2 report and we’ll route it to legal.
- Confirm the technical call attendees; we’ll have Karthik (infra/security) and Monica (legal/compliance) on the call.
